text:
Sam: Hey folks — quick personal update! I accepted a promotion to Senior Engineering Manager 🎉 and will be moving to Seattle next month. Would love to celebrate with the team — thinking cake in the kitchen on Fri 4/26 around 12:30pm. LMK if that works :tada:
Priya: OMG congrats Sam!! so well deserved :tada::tada:
Devon: Huge congrats!! I can make Friday
Maya: Congrats Sam!! 12:30 is good for me too — helps with people who have calls earlier/later
HR Bot: Congrats @Sam! Please remember to submit the manager transfer form (link: /hr-transfer) and ping People Ops for relocation support. We can also help with moving stipend details.
Liam: Congrats!! :clap: Could we get a vegan cake option? A few on my side would appreciate it
Sam: Absolutely yes to vegan — thanks for flagging, Liam. I'll order from Bluebird Bakery unless anyone has recs. I'll bring coffee as well ☕️
Priya: I'll put a note in the team board and update calendars once we lock the time
Devon: I'll add a quick line: "Sam promo + sendoff — Fri 4/26 12:30" to the board
Maya: Quick poll: does Tue/Wed/Thu OR Fri work better if folks prefer earlier in the week? (Poll options: Tue / Wed / Thu / Fri)
Liam: Fri still my vote but otherwise Wed works too
Sam: Thanks everyone — Friday is easiest for me because of moving prep earlier in week. Appreciate all the support. Happy to do a short shoutout in next all-hands if folks want to hear about the role change
Priya: yes please, that would be awesome :confetti_ball:
Devon: Adding a :party_popper: reaction and congrats again!
Maya: Congrats again Sam — we'll celebrate proper cake-style :cake: 
HR Bot: Note: @Sam, I scheduled a quick 1:1 with People Ops to go over relocation next Tue. You can reschedule if that conflicts.
